summary: Waterloo-engineering video journal: talking-head cold open, music-led b-roll with silent written narration, long unhurried talk with jump cuts and no music under it, loud music-only montages, glitch-collage chapter cards with lowercase date stamps, full-bleed stretched slam text, brand card to close.

sources.title: first co-op term of uwaterloo engineering
git for video editing
sources.note: product-launch short; typography and slam text only, excluded from pooled rhythm and levels
